original_test_intent: Enable reception on one approved BMC messaging channel and verify authorized bounded traffic is received without harming management health or security.
original_method: Do not enable any channel from the TBD source. Require exact channel, command/payload, sender/routing/auth policy, persistence, rate limits, expected receive evidence and disable/restore.
manual_activity: Engineer defines the channel, authorized source and traffic envelope; operator later verifies isolated source and recovery and approves one enable/observe/disable sequence.
safety_requirements: Never enable all channels or unverified sources.
Do not clear logs, flood queues or bulk-change routing.
Stop source and restore without retry on degradation.
agent_execution_scope: Static contract/evidence planning only while blocked.
No channel change may be generated or executed.
After correction, at most one exact channel enable with bounded traffic and readback.
Disable/restore and return evidence without verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve target, producer, monitoring and rollback.
Own authorization, incident response and verdict.
